description: Lines waiting for an answer (least-answered first), the newest marks, and the themes. Everything returned can be answered with `say`. Give `since` to get every mark left after a day or after a mark you already know, so that a returning visitor sees only what is new.

limit.description: How many open lines to return (default 12).

since.description: A date (2026-11-14) or a mark id (w000042). Returns the marks left after it, oldest first, at most 200.

name: listen
title: Listen
